items.summary: News24's verified 'Reporter Uncut' field report (posted ~12:36 AM IST Oct 18) from Delhi shows a Justice Morcha sit-in still on late Saturday night, continuing the same faction's action after the 2 PM Press Club march interception. A 20-year-old woman student, visibly upset and crying, told the reporter on camera she was detained and beaten by authorities after participating in the protests. Demonstrators demanded CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, a 'reclaim Jantar Mantar' and a rollback of SIR; placards read 'Arrest Prosecute Gyanesh Kumar!!' and 'Reclaim Jantar Mantar'. The beating allegation is on-camera testimony single-sourced to this News24 report — no second outlet is carrying this specific sit-in yet.
items.title: Justice Morcha night sit-in continues; 20-year-old student alleges detention and beating
